scripts.ci:build: bun test apps/app/tests && (cd apps/app && bunx tsc --noEmit) && bun run build && (cd apps/app && bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run)
scripts.release: cd apps/app && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply qesuite-re --remote --config wrangler.jsonc && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: cd apps/app && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply qesuite-re --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: cd apps/app && bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply qesuite-re --remote
